title: Tunisian Sweet Raspberry Tagine
description: A traditional Tunisian stew with the sweetness of raspberries, perfect for a dessert or snack.

ingredients.name: Nourishing Tagine Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a mixture of cinnamon, ginger, and cumin

ingredients.name: Almond milk
ingredients.notes: or substitute with other non-dairy milk

instructions: 1. Heat the coconut oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
2. Add the tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
3. Add the raspberries, coconut sugar, and lemon juice. Cook for 5 minutes, until the sugar has dissolved.
4. Pour in the almond milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
5. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 10-15 minutes, until the sauce has thickened slightly.
6. Serve warm, garnished with additional raspberries if desired.
